Our approach

A useful guide.
A clear point of view.

We help people buy thoughtful gifts for pilots and aviation enthusiasts, even when they don’t know aviation equipment.

Who makes this guide?

Pilot Gift Guide is an editorial resource for people choosing gifts for pilots, their families and aviation enthusiasts. We publish ranked shortlists, comparisons and ideas for days out. This site does not sell products or accept orders.

Our relationship with ATC

Pilot Gift Guide is produced by the team behind ATC, the airport-listening app. Some guides recommend our own app, and those entries carry a disclosure beside the recommendation. These are editorial recommendations, not independent customer reviews.

How we rank our picks

Rankings are our editorial judgment, not lab scores or a measure of sales popularity. Within each guide we prioritize suitability for its intended recipient, usefulness or personal appeal, and how easily the buyer can confirm fit. Price and compatibility can change the order for an individual reader. Product shortlists cover the models named, not every option available. Numbered checklists explain a decision in order; they do not represent product performance scores. General gift ideas are suggestions to personalize, not claims that a particular seller offers a package.

How products are selected

We consider who a gift suits, its listed price, how much compatibility information the buyer needs, and whether it is sensible as a surprise. Our first collection draws on public listings from Sporty’s, Pilot Mall, and LEGO. We write our own buying advice. We do not claim to have personally tested these products.

Prices and links

Product prices were checked on October 20, 2026. They are snapshots, exclude tax and shipping, and can vary by configuration. Retailer pages are the source of truth for availability, specifications, returns and delivery. No third-party affiliate tracking has been added to these links, and other featured brands have not sponsored this guide.

Product imagery

Product images are sourced from the linked manufacturer and retailer listings and remain the property of their respective owners. They illustrate the specific products discussed. Our guide covers combine editorial photography and product imagery. They illustrate each topic; not every item in a cover appears in every related shortlist. Aviation photographs: Cody F, Nick Morales, ALPEN AIR, and Tomas Martinez, used under the Unsplash License.

Make the final choice with the pilot

Headsets, tablet accessories and other cockpit equipment require compatibility checks. Our gift suggestions are not flight instruction, operational guidance or a substitute for the recipient’s equipment requirements.
